title: The World Wars
description:
S01 E02 — A Rising Threat
After the fighting stops, tensions continue to simmer just beneath the surface, and few realize that the seeds of the next great global conflict have already been sown; Jeremy Renner narrates.

title: The World Wars
description:
S01 E03 — Never Surrender
World leaders are called to action as war inevitably breaks out again; the men who came of age during wartime must rely upon experiences to fight a new conflict, as they face the greatest challenge humanity has ever seen; Jeremy Renner narrates.

description:

description:

description:

description:

description:

description:

The ancient Roman pilum is designed to penetrate armor; World War II army radios; how rockets were first used on the battlefield.

title: Washington
description:
S01 E03 — Father of His Country
The Revolution has been won, but as warring nations attack America's borders and uprisings threaten from within, Washington builds the new United States up with his bare hands while enduring treachery and personal attacks.

title: Washington
description:
S01 E01 — Loyal Subject
Sent by the British to deliver an ultimatum, the inexperienced young officer learns a hard lesson about leadership when his failures in the field inadvertently kick off a world war.

title: Washington
description:
S01 E02 — Rebel Commander
As the American colonies make their final break, their newly minted commander-in-chief realizes he's been handed a nearly impossible task in fighting the most powerful armed force in the world with an undisciplined ragtag group of soldiers.

title: Lost Worlds
description:
S02 E16 — Ivan the Terrible's Fortresses
Ivan the Terrible, Russia's first czar, originates the secret police, is a ruthless military leader, destroys great cities and builds new fortresses as he expands the borders of his realm.

title: Lost Worlds
description:
S02 E11 — Lost Superpower of the Bible
Operating from their capital of Hattusha in what is now Turkey, the Hittites were a highly advanced military powerhouse that disappeared almost as quickly as they appeared in the ancient world.

title: Lost Worlds
description:
S02 E13 — City of Armageddon
Overlooking the Holy Land's Dead Sea is the ancient fortress of Masada, where Jewish rebels besieged by Roman soldiers staged a last stand until committing mass suicide.

title: Lost Worlds
description:
S01 E02 — Knights Templar
The city the Knights Templar knew as Tortosa now lies among modern homes in the Syrian city of Tartus.

title: Lost Worlds
description:
S02 E12 — Stalin's Supercity
Soviet dictator Josef Stalin causes the suffering and deaths of millions of citizens while envisaging a grandiose architectural plan.

title: Lost Worlds
description:
S02 E15 — The Age of Airships
Gigantic buildings house airships, the largest vehicles ever flown.

title: Decisive Battles
description:
Birth of the Roman Empire
The Battle of Cynoscephalae against Macedonia in 197 B.C. removes Rome's last rival for power in the Mediterranean.
